incremental load logic in the dim_customers model (e.g., merge/upsert not handling existing keys correctly)

args.evidence: stg_customers has 1500 rows with 1500 distinct customer_key (no duplicates). dim_customers has 7500 rows but only 1500 distinct customer_key, indicating each key appears 5 times. The dim_customers model joins stg_customers to stg_nations correctly, but the join to stg_regions uses `on n.region_key = n.region_key` (always true) instead of `on r.region_key = n.region_key`, causing a cross join with 5 region rows and multiplying each customer row by 5, creating duplicate customer_key rows. Fix the join condition.
